name: Sam's Club Cafe (Logan & Riverdale, UT) Warm Salted Soft Pretzel (Hold Mustard)
whyItWorks: Warm, fluffy baked yeast pretzel dough. Zero seeds, low-fat, and highly comforting for gut fatigue during warehouse shopping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the warm soft pretzel with light salt; enjoy plain without spicy dipping sauces.
watchOuts: Brush off excess coarse salt if sodium-sensitive
